name: anim_trio_dopun
subject: a pink goo Doberman monster pressed down on top of a pink goo crocodile monster on a sticky paint puddle, hugging it, with a small black witch cat squashed between them
desc: Small change only: with a wet plop the small black cat sinks completely into the pink goo between the two monsters and disappears entirely, swallowed by their bodies; no black, no hat, no cat visible at all anymore, only a small ripple and bulge of pink goo where it sank. Everything else stays the same: the Doberman pressed down hugging the crocodile, same lying pose, both heads and faces unchanged, same colors and yellow marble streaks.
